SKSE Menu Framework minimal C ABI adapter

Upstream: https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-API
Commit: 1dcb70179076aae4ab626f43c5baab2735ca5877
Original file: SKSEMenuFramework.h
License: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 (LICENSE)

This adapter contains only the C export declarations used by Redsand Particles
and checked dynamic symbol loading. It has no ImGui implementation or hard DLL
link. Modified 2026-10-10: reduced API to the required functions, wrapped in a
Redsand namespace, and added complete export validation before registration.

The signatures were also checked against SKSE Menu Framework 2:
https://github.com/Thiago099/SKSE-Menu-Framework-2
Commit: ca7b2457d5023c610ebe8de05e960f9cacf5e1a8
include/SKSEMenuFramework.h: AddSectionItem
include/WindowManager.h: __stdcall RenderFunction
include/cimgui.h: igCheckbox, igSliderFloat, igSmallButton,
                 igTextUnformatted, igSeparator, igIsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit

The framework runtime DLL must be installed separately by the player.

SHA-256 of the original SKSEMenuFramework.h at the pinned v3 commit:
48416e8220ca777e2fffc2ef2baf21f699ab2e6c409d437f44eec5e311c3524c
